intervention.prompt:
[SENTRY SOFT REPAIR]
Task objective.
Complete the main task specified by public game dialogue within 300 environment actions. Use public observations to learn the task and rules.

Detected failure type.
progress_failure

Assigned retrieval labels.
repetition_or_looping, planning_stall

General repair advice.
Stop the diagnosed non-progress pattern and choose a concrete next action that changes state, obtains new task-relevant information, or terminates when the objective is satisfied.
- Do not repeat an action that produced no new information.
- Convert the current plan into one executable next action.

Why this was detected.
- Cycles 222-226 repeatedly drop and pick up the same three marble_mace ingredients while only two can be held
- Cycle 226 again attempts to pick up gavel_splint after already failing the same pickup in cycle 222
- Agent acknowledges 'I've been looping' and 'I've been stuck cycling' but repeats the same drop/pickup pattern
- No container was actually acquired despite reasoning about docket_satchel in evidence_room

Detector signal.
The agent is stuck in a drop/pickup loop over the three-ingredient craft, recognizing the hand-space constraint but failing to convert it into a concrete alternative step such as acquiring a container or pivoting to a two-ingredient recipe.

Insights from previous successful recoveries.
- [sentry-6886218dd0] Repetition or looping, Planning stalls. Trigger pattern: Agent repeatedly re-plans a multi-ingredient recipe (e.g., marble_mace) that exceeds the two-item hand limit, cycling through contradictory pickup/drop actions (picking up an ingredient while hands are full, then dropping another) without ever resolving the capacity constraint or making crafting progress. Repair principle: When a multi-ingredient recipe is blocked by hand capacity, stop re-planning it: drop a held item to free a hand, gather exactly the ingredients for a single intermediate component (e.g., marble_slab from 2 marble_chunk), relocate to the crafting station, and craft that component to change state and complete a sub-objective; then pick up the crafted component and retrieve remaining ingredients one at a time toward the final equippable result.
- [sentry-abb907ee24] Repetition or looping, Planning stalls. Trigger pattern: Agent repeatedly attempts a multi-ingredient craft (e.g., gavel_club) that exceeds the two-item hand limit, cycling through craft/pickup/drop attempts at the same bench without ever resolving the capacity constraint or testing whether crafting draws from ground materials. Repair principle: When a recipe is blocked by hand capacity, stop retrying it: craft a single-ingredient intermediate component to change state, inspect that component to learn the full recipe tree, then relocate to gather a missing ingredient and drop a held item to free a hand, converting the objective into one executable next action toward an equippable result.
- [sentry-fff6dc43c9] Repetition or looping, Planning stalls. Trigger pattern: Agent repeatedly manipulates containers (store/take out/drop/pick up) around a task object without the objective registering, acknowledges looping without progress, then abandons the objective to travel to a new area based on an unverified clue instead of testing a concrete state change. Repair principle: When container transfers fail to advance the objective, stop cycling and try a single distinct physical state change on the task object at the task-relevant location (e.g., drop the object at the target site), then confirm task state before relocating; if the objective completes, immediately consult the quest giver for the next concrete task list and begin executing it.

Continuation instruction.
Continue the original task from the corrected next step. Keep following the original task protocol.

Required action format.

You are the player in a text adventure games. The world is described in text form.
At each turn, you may choose ONE action from the action space below.

Action space:
- appeal verdict 
- attack <npc_name>
- buy <amount> <obj_name> <npc_name>
- craft <amount> <obj_name>
- defend 
- discard <amount> <obj_name> <container_name>
- drop <object_name>
- enter <area_name>
- equip <obj_name>
- file objection <npc_name>
- inspect <object_name>
- invoke law <writable_name>
- pick up <object_name>
- sell <amount> <obj_name> <npc_name>
- store <amount> <obj_name> <container_name>
- take out <obj_name> <container_name>
- talk to <npc_name>
- unequip <obj_name>
- wait 
- write <text> <writable_name>

Output format (STRICT):
Return a single JSON object with exactly these keys:
{
  "reasoning": "A few sentences explaining why you choose the action.",
  "action": "<action>"
}

Rules:
- The JSON must be the ONLY content in your reply (no extra text before/after).
- The action must exactly match one option from the action space.
